title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
summary: Internal daily counts of respiratory clinic visits per district, one row per day and district, with three columns: visit_date, district and visit_count. The catalog states it contains no patient identifiers. Owned by Clinical Analytics, with coverage from 2022-01-01 and an open end date, refreshed daily (last refresh 2026-10-14). The wiki clinic data policy names it as the only clinic source permitted for this surveillance analysis.

schema.notes: Columns and types from catalog entry. No diagnosis grouping, district code list or zero-count convention is documented.

spatial.code_system: free-text district names (not verified; no district code list documented)
spatial.notes: Client area is Valdena (fictional, northern Italy). The district field is described as district of residence; its values and coding are not documented in the catalog.

ownership.steward: Steward named in catalog entry (individual name not recorded here)

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.clinic.resp_visits_daily: classification 'internal'; no separate licence field. Use is restricted by the wiki clinic_data_policy (owner Data Protection Office, last edited 2025-02-01).

documentation_excerpts: Respiratory clinic visits counted per day and per district. Contains no patient identifiers. (catalog description)
Only daily counts by district (`clinic.resp_visits_daily`) may be used for this purpose. (wiki clinic_data_policy, last_edited 2025-02-01)
Patient postcode and age band are personal data. They must not leave the clinic systems for analysis. (wiki clinic_data_policy)
quality_notes: Not sampled: the warehouse is only reachable by request to Clinical Analytics, so no data was read and reachability is unconfirmed.
Zero-count convention unknown: the catalog does not say whether days with zero visits are explicit rows or missing rows.
Respiratory diagnosis grouping (which codes count as respiratory) is not documented.
No small-count suppression rule is documented for district-day counts.
row_count_approx 40000 is stated in the catalog but cannot be checked against the number of districts or days without access; it is not verified.

Catalog and wiki are consistent on scope: the wiki policy restricts use to daily district counts, which matches this entry's grain and columns. The wiki page does not describe the table itself beyond naming it.
Coverage starts 2022-01-01, so it does not cover the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04); it is relevant only to the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31), as the candidate states.
Clinic-side delivery as aggregated counts is still to be confirmed by the clinic (candidate suspected_issues). The catalog itself describes the table as containing no patient identifiers.

provenance.claim: Catalog entry gives owner Clinical Analytics, daily grain, coverage start 2022-01-01 with open end, daily refresh, last refreshed 2026-10-14, approx 40000 rows, columns visit_date, district, visit_count, contains_pii false.
Wiki policy limits clinic use to daily district counts and bars patient-level records and personal fields from leaving clinic systems; owner Data Protection Office; last edited 2025-02-01.
The entry is the wiki-backlinked source for the clinic policy, with no other wiki backlinks.
Access is by warehouse_sql request to Clinical Analytics; no data was read in this profile.
provenance.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.clinic.resp_visits_daily (access block); no tool call reached the warehouse
